```{r}
install.packages("fortunes")
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")

gt(head(rhinovirus))
```
```{r}
library(fortunes)
```
```{r}
fortune()
```
```{r}
cell_id <- c("CX1", "CX2")
treated <- c(TRUE, FALSE)
n_before <- c(5415, 8123)
n_after <- c(1432, 7543)
print(cell_id[2])
```
```{r}
ggplot(rhinovirus, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") + 
  xlab("Year") + 
  ylab("Percentage") + 
  ggtitle("percentage of positive PCR results for rhinovirus")
```
